CRM contact import, read only: HubSpot lists (lists/search, memberships/join-order, contacts/batch/read at 100) and Zoho CRM views (token refresh, settings/custom_views, Contacts by cvid with page_token). A pull is an upload on a crm source, mapped by source.map (agent contract included) and saved by source.commit; source.sync re-imports with the last mapping; idempotent on the CRM id (intake_crm_record keeps a hash of the number): unchanged records skipped, a changed number flagged and left out. Consent and DND only from CRM fields that say so; otherwise unknown. Docs used: research/2026-10-24/crm-import/README.md.

Salesforce contact import, read only: Contact and Lead list views (listviews, list view describe for the view's own SOQL, object describe for field-level security, COUNT() then query with nextRecordsUrl). Per-org API budget (1,000 calls per rolling 24 h unless set with source.crm.budget.set; never past 90% of the org's limit per Sforce-Limit-Info): a pull counts first, re-checks before every page and stops with nothing imported; the calls used are on the receipt (converted.apiCalls). Fields the user may not read get no column and are named (converted.unreadable). DoNotCall is an opt-out. CRM reads run in prepare, outside the transaction. Payment status (payments.ts): Razorpay (payment.captured, order.paid, payment_link.paid), Cashfree (PAYMENT_SUCCESS) and PayU (status=success) webhooks, each verified with the gateway's own scheme before anything is read; kept once per gateway payment id; matched to exactly one live contact by the record key the workspace names (reference_id, receipt, notes, order_id, order_tags, customer_id, txnid, udf1-5), never by the payer's phone; ambiguous and unmatched are kept 30 days. paidSinceImport() for campaigns' G4 ('already_paid'): a payment counts unless the record was observed more than a day after it. Optional verified outcome on the person's latest call in the 14 days before paying (calls' recordVerified). Tools source.payments.setup / source.payments.list; web Contacts > Import > Payments (lazy chunk). Docs: research/2026-10-24/payment-webhooks/README.md.

dial_time_attributes.rule: Every attribute row has one current value per (contact_id, key) with authority, observed_at, max_age_s and source_id. A value is usable for dial-time facts only while observed_at + max_age_s > now (max_age_s null = no expiry). Stale values must not be spoken (campaigns reason ATTRIBUTE_STALE); contact.get returns stale per key.
dial_time_attributes.self_subjects: name, first_name, last_name, language, timezone, preferred_time, preferred_channel, address_as, pace: person 100 > agent 60 > crm 50 = upload 50 > system 30. name, language and timezone are mirrored onto contact columns; read those.
dial_time_attributes.record_subjects: every other key (amount_due, due_date, plan, status, record keys, external_id ...): system 100 > crm 80 > agent 75 > upload 70 > person 40. Amounts and dates may be spoken only from these rows, never from speech.
dial_time_attributes.never_attributes: Aadhaar, PAN, bank, card, OTP and password columns are dropped at mapping and never stored. Consent, opt-out and DND are ledgers (consent_record, suppression, dnd_status), not attributes; use contact.dial_facts.
dial_time_attributes.freshness_defaults: upload 30 days, crm and system 24 h, agent and person no expiry; a source can set its own max age.
dial_time_attributes.age_keys: date_of_birth (ISO date), birth_year (number), age, age_group (text such as 13-17), is_minor are canonical; see AGE_KEY_SYNONYMS / canonicalAgeKey exported from intake/index.ts
dial_time_attributes.consent_order: latest consent per purpose (or all) = ORDER BY effective_at DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC

notes: Display ORDER BYs use the database collation on purpose (names read in the locale); the one comparison that decides membership (audience filter gt/lt on text) uses COLLATE "C".
